notes.title: XO Evolved Update - v1.0.0
notes.content:
The highlight of this update is the new "Territory" game variant, combining classic Tic-Tac-Toe with XO Evolved tactics! In this mode, players can control tiles using lasers from their shapes, adding to their point total alongside traditional three-in-a-rows. Utilize shape positioning to claim tiles and disrupt your opponent's territory! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41777497/905c67cdc00c1396eb9cd0dcf073e9d02197bd31.gif[/img]

Try this mode out now against your friends or the AI opponent. Other features included in this update are bug fixes, new customization options, and the 60th Campaign Level.

Thank you for playing XO Evolved!

notes.title: XO Evolved Update - Version 0.9
notes.content:
Daily Rewards System:
Log in every day to claim random Coin or Card rewards. As you log in and claim this reward daily, your streak increases, improving your chances at better rewards. Stay consistent every month to maximize your gains and build your collection faster!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41777497/adb000166e3ac1a981b1e1d74bde27dc4f351028.gif[/img]

Favorites System:
The new "Favorites" feature in the "Edit Hands" menu allows you to mark your most-used cards as favorites, making them stand out from the rest and easier to find. Quickly detect for best cards and assemble your strategies.

Game Modifiers in Network Mode:
Add a new layer of excitement to your multiplayer matches with game modifiers! Before starting a game against other players, you can now change various game rules to create unique challenges and experiences. Mix things up and discover new ways to enjoy XO Evolved with your friends and the community.

This update enhances the player experience with more rewards, better organization, and increased customization. Log in now to start claiming your daily rewards!

notes.title: XO Evolved Update - Version 0.89
notes.content:
Embark on an enhanced journey through XO Evolved in the latest update, designed to elevate your learning experience! Our redesigned tutorial now features a sleek navigation menu, allowing you to navigate through various game-play topics and master the intricacies of the game at your own pace. Each topic is accompanied with updated, detailed descriptions, providing comprehensive insights into every aspect of game-play.

In addition to the tutorial improvements, we've revamped the Local/AI menu, making it easier to set up matches against human or computer opponents.

Along side the new menu, 8 new cards were added, each offering unique strategic possibilities to outsmart your opponents.

For those seeking even greater challenges, try to conquer the new campaign levels 51 through 55, each presenting exciting scenarios to overcome. 

Don't miss out on these thrilling updates – download the latest version of XO Evolved today and embark on a journey of strategy, skill, and endless excitement!

notes.title: XO Evolved Update - Version 0.88
notes.content:
The focal point of this update is the redesigned Card Shop, offering a more intuitive and efficient way to expand your card collection. You can now buy multiple cards at the same time, streamlining your journey to assemble the ultimate deck.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41777497/a257bd0a21d3ab3dda454dde3e1909d7b48cd55c.png[/img]

This update also introduces three brand-new cards to shake up your tactics and add fresh dimensions to your gameplay. Explore these new additions and experiment with innovative strategies as you navigate the ever-evolving battlefield of XO Evolved.

notes.title: XO Evolved Version 0.85
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41777497/7aee9df22ac4452b2fa0c71b200131297aefeec6.gif[/img]

This update of XO Evolved adds a variety of cards and effects to allow players to achieve tactical advantages. Here is a list of a small subset of the additions
[list]
[*] Evasive: Evasive is a new status effect that can currently be applied through 2 card effects. If the unit inflicted with Evasive would be hit by a laser and there is exactly one unit adjacent to the unit, the positions of the two units are swapped.
[*] Laser Previews: As displayed above, "Laser Previews" is a feature that allows players to see the path their laser will take. This accounts for mirrors and units placed on the board that redirect or alter the laser's path.
[*] Laser VFX Shop: This is a new shop that displays different visual effects for lasers cast.
[*] Killstreak: Killstreak is a Unique card with the following effect: "If you cast a laser that destroys at least 2 units, gain an extra turn and refund the laser cost. If this effect activates, increase the unit count by 1."
[*] Possess: Possess is a common card with the following effect: Inflict Possessed to target unit or move Possessed unit to target empty tile.
[/list]

Be sure to check out the full list of changes in game!

notes.content:

notes.title: Laser Rework
notes.content: Instead of a player being able to use a laser whenever possible, they must now pay crystals, a game-only resource. Each player starts a game with five crystals, and they acquire one every turn. A player's first laser costs five, but every use will increase future costs by one, so use them wisely!
